guards.new:
This construction fixes the
suspension representatives used in the Wang complex and is compatible
with the based product-cell comparison in P1.12.

In degree six the compatibility has the following marked check.
The integral kernel of $\bigwedge^5M_0-I$ has basis
\[
x_j=a_1\wedge a_2\wedge a_3\wedge
b_1\wedge\cdots\widehat{b_j}\cdots\wedge b_3
\quad(j=1,2,3),
\]
with signs fixed by this exterior order.  Each is the top class of
the invariant five-torus $b_j=0$.  Its mapping torus gives the
suspension lift $(0,x_j)$.  Cellular approximation can be performed
on the finitely many transported five-tori and their intersections
before extension over the ambient torus.  The comparison chains
stay in those five-tori and contribute no six-dimensional fibre
chain.  Along the two inverse edge cylinders the coordinates are
therefore exactly $-W_2W_0x_j$ and $-W_0x_j$, as in (1.12.3).
The possible added fibre top class is also detected by the closed
flat fibre-volume form $\omega=dx_0\wedge\cdots\wedge dx_5$.
Both monodromies have determinant one, so this form is well-defined.
It integrates to zero on these transported five-torus prisms and to
one on the marked fibre top class.  Two lifts with the displayed
edge coordinates differ by an element of the integral fibre
summand in the graph Wang sequence; this evaluation makes that
element zero.  Thus the comparison includes the fibre coordinate.
Formula (1.19.1) maps this particular six-cycle over the
two-dimensional base torus $b_j=0$, with angular fibres of dimension
at most three, so its cusp image has zero sixth homology class.
